692	When you see Eretz Yisrael flourishing, it means that the redemption
693	is near, as it says: "But you, mountains of Israel, you shall yield your branches and bear your fruit
694	for My people Israel, for they are soon to come." For when we went out
695	into exile, Eretz Yisrael received an instruction: "and your enemies who dwell in it shall be desolate over it" —
696	it would not give fruit to anyone,
697	it would stay faithful to the people of Israel, because it is
698	small. And if the nations had built it up, we would
699	have had nowhere to return. It was supposed to be filled
700	with nations from end to end. Therefore, everyone who tried to build
701	and make it flourish did not succeed. The people of Israel return, Eretz
702	Yisrael flourishes. The Gemara says: if you see
703	Eretz Yisrael yielding fruit again, instead of
704	swamps and fever and malaria, know that Mashiach is about
705	to arrive. This is the greatest sign. There are many more
706	signs, which we went over in past lessons, many
707	signs, we will not repeat them, that were said about that period.

714	state. Eliyahu HaNavi is revealed when the time comes, and anoints
715	him as king. That is why he is called Mashiach, drawn with the anointing oil.
